name: schedule_create
description: Create a new schedule. A schedule runs a prompt or tool on a cron expression against a target agent or session. Use standard cron syntax (e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' for weekdays at 9 AM).

prompt.description: The prompt or instruction to execute when the schedule fires

cron_expression.description: Cron expression defining when the schedule runs (e.g. '0 9 * * *' for daily at 9 AM)

agent_id.description: ID of the agent to target. Provide either agent_id or session_id.

session_id.description: ID of the session to target. Provide either agent_id or session_id.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the cron expression (e.g. 'America/New_York')

action_type.description: 'message' sends the prompt as a message; 'tool' executes the prompt as a tool call

tool_name.description: Tool name to invoke when action_type is 'tool'
